name: y1_plv_prior_budget
label: EXPLORATORY / post-hoc simulation on logged training-time rollouts; not a pre-registered test

protocol.regret: max_c H(c) - H(pick); H = held-out success (25 episodes) within the problem's checkpoint set
protocol.budget: B = round(mult * N), N = all checkpoints of the problem (prior or not)
protocol.prior_subset: top ceil(0.3 N) by the prior; ties -> later epoch; combos = mean of within-problem ranks
protocol.ci: percentile over seed-bootstrap replicates (pool & held-out seeds resampled with replacement, shared across checkpoints and runs); replicate 0 = original seeds, used for point estimates
protocol.crossing: smallest grid mult with (mean-over-runs regret - reference) <= 0.02; reference = perfect-judge no-prior uniform at 25N (all 25 pool episodes); 50 = not reached
